title: Troubleshooting: a skill that never goes obsolete
summary: Frames troubleshooting as stepping back, understanding system flows, and isolating causes through scientific hypothesis testing.
when-to-read: Read when stuck debugging an unfamiliar system and need a structured investigative method, or when learning to troubleshoot in a new domain. Do not read for language- or tool-specific debugging commands — this is a domain-agnostic mental framework, not a technical reference.
